tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by two different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Nvidia's Jensen Huang tells CNBC that U.S. and Chinese artificial intelligence companies should work together on safety through dialogue rather than regulation to manage risks. Confirmed by CNBC.
DeepSeek experienced a major outage lasting nearly five hours, and the company is offering users week-long refunds. Confirmed by South China Morning Post.
Apple Intelligence is planned for launch in China during December, with approvals from Alibaba's artificial intelligence model. Still open, per NeoTeo.
Amazon has launched new Bee personal artificial intelligence devices, including wearables and a card-sized recorder that listen to conversations. Confirmed by CNBC.
Google DeepMind is opening a new robotics lab in Cambridge, led by a former Boston Dynamics executive. Confirmed by The Verge.
Free every hour.
